title: SalamAir Resumes Muscat–Tehran–Muscat Direct Flights After Months-Long Hiatus
text:
SalamAir Resumes Muscat–Tehran–Muscat Direct Flights After Months-Long Hiatus"

"🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 18, 2026 — Oman’s SalamAir has resumed its direct Muscat–Tehran–Muscat service after a months-long suspension, with the first flight arriving at Imam Khomeini Airport City."

"The resumption restores direct air links between Oman and Iran on the route, marking the end of a prolonged pause in SalamAir’s Tehran operations."

"Moment of the first SalamAir flight’s arrival at Imam Khomeini Airport City.
